.. py:function:: get_processed_city_name(city_name: str) -> str

   Process the railstation name in SNCF punctuality rate csv file
   to match with railstation name in the other files

   :param city_name: the city name from SNCF punctuality rate csv file
   :type city_name: str

   :returns: the processed name to match with others SNCF files data
   :rtype: str
